# Flip

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Mirrors a native subtree about its box centre without changing flow dimensions.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IContentContainer`, `IStatefulElement`.

